word-email.def: a message sent from one computer to another over the internet

word-song.def: a short piece of music with words that you sing

word-news.def: information about things that have just happened

word-story.def: a description of events, either true or made up

word-picture.def: a drawing, painting or photo that shows something

word-idea.def: a thought or plan that comes into your mind

word-reason.def: the cause of something, or the explanation for why it happens

word-example.def: one thing that shows what a whole group or type is like

word-busy.def: having a lot of things to do, so not free

word-ready.def: completely prepared and able to start

word-possible.def: able to happen or to be done

word-true.def: agreeing with the facts; not false

word-full.def: holding as much as it can, with no space left

word-heavy.def: weighing a lot and hard to lift

word-light-weight.def: weighing very little and easy to lift

word-strong.def: having great physical power or force

word-weak.def: without much physical power or force

word-interesting.def: making you want to know or learn more

word-boring.def: dull and not able to hold your attention

word-favorite.def: liked more than all others of its kind

word-really.def: used to say that something is true, or to add strength to what you say

phrase-how-much-is-it.def: a question you ask to find out what you must pay for something

phrase-where-is-toilet.def: a question you ask to find a room with a toilet

phrase-i-dont-know.def: what you say when you have no information or answer
